一束光就是一个个光子；只要 ν > νc，光再弱也立刻有电子出来: A beam of light is a stream of photons; as long as ν > νc, electrons come out at once, however weak the light
一个光子把 hν 全部交给一个电子；光强只加光子个数: One photon hands all of hν to one electron; brighter light only means more photons
电子交出逸出功 W₀ 才出得来，剩下 Ek = hν − W₀: An electron must pay the work function W₀ to get out, leaving Ek = hν − W₀
反向电压把电子顶回去，Uc 归零时 eUc = Ek —— 所以 Uc 与光强无: A reverse voltage pushes electrons back; when the current reaches zero at Uc, eUc = Ek, so Uc does not depend on light intensity
换频率测 Uc：Uc-ν 是一条斜率 h/e 的直线 → 量出普朗克常量: Change the frequency and measure Uc: Uc vs ν is a straight line of slope h/e, which gives Planck's constant

真实档三处偏差是固定常数，同一个工况永远同一组读数（确定性，不是随机误差）。: The three deviations in the real setting are fixed constants: the same conditions always give the same readings (deterministic, not random error).
两处误差方向相反、要分开算再合：分度让 Uc_测 偏大 0～+0.01 V（这次: The two errors point in opposite directions and must be worked out separately before combining: the step size makes Uc_measured 0 to +0.01 V high (+0.0008 this time), the +0.4 % scale makes it 0.0044 V low, together 1.09 V.
超量程只让 I_sat 测小、Uc 不受影响（反向段电流只有 0.1–0.6 μ: Exceeding the range only makes I_sat read low; Uc is not affected (the reverse current is only 0.1–0.6 μA).
去掉这一步：学生会把「测出来和教材表不一样」当成自己算错。: Without this step: students think "my measurement differs from the textbook table" means they calculated wrongly.
实验素养：说出真实器材的误差来源与方向（课标「科学探究」）；必考：W₀ 为什么要: Lab skills: name the error sources of real equipment and their direction (curriculum "scientific inquiry"); exam staple: why W₀ must be measured. The 2.29 eV in the textbook table is the nominal value for "sodium as a metal", and the surface of this tube's cathode is different.
考核：给一只没标定的真实管子，你该选哪条谱线、多强、加到多少，才算测出了一个合格: Assessment: given an uncalibrated real tube, which spectral line, what intensity and how much voltage do you need to measure a valid Uc?
选一条能激发它的谱线、光强别太大，再反向扫到读数第一次归零那一格停住，保持 10: Choose a spectral line that can excite it, keep the intensity moderate, then scan in reverse and stop on the step where the reading first reaches zero; hold for 10 s
进入时（真实档 · 钠 · 577.0 nm · 400 μW · 正向 U =: On entry (real setting · sodium · 577.0 nm · 400 μW · forward U = 0.00): I = 0.000 μA, Uc box "—", status "No photoelectrons (frequency below cutoff)": this light cannot excite this tube; at forward 6.00 V the I_sat box would top out at 5.000 μA (the saturation current at this setting exceeds 80 % of the range). One passing solution: sodium · 365.0 nm · 200 μW, stopping on the reverse 1.09 V step → Uc box 1.09 V, saturation current at this setting 2.994 μA; from W₀ = hν/e − Uc, 3.3992 − 1.09 = 2.31 eV (this tube's actual value is 2.305 eV, the textbook table's nominal value 2.29 eV).
没有新结论：ν > νc 才有电子、反向要加到读数恰为 0.000 且是第一次归: No new conclusion: electrons appear only for ν > νc; Uc is the reverse voltage where the reading is exactly 0.000 for the first time; when Uc is too small (< 0.10 V) two or three steps cannot measure it accurately; the intensity must not be so high that the saturation current at that setting exceeds the range. All four came up in earlier steps; W₀ = hν/e − Uc is the single-point use of the step 7 line on the same tube.
真实器材 · 钠 · 365.0 nm · 200 μW · Uc_测 1.09: Real equipment · sodium · 365.0 nm · 200 μW · Uc_measured 1.09 V
先判断这束光能不能激发这只管子（ν vs νc），再谈测量。: First decide whether this light can excite this tube (ν vs νc), then measure.
反向必须扫到读数恰为 0.000 且是第一次归零；停在 0.002 会把 Uc: The reverse scan must reach a reading of exactly 0.000 for the first time; stopping at 0.002 measures Uc one step low, and stopping past the zero gives no reading.
Uc 只有两三格（< 0.10 V）的工况测不准；光强要选到让这一档的饱和电流: Conditions where Uc is only two or three steps (< 0.10 V) cannot be measured accurately; choose an intensity whose saturation current is ≤ 4.000 μA (80 % of the range).
去掉这一步：三条规律都停在「知道」，没有一个工况是学生自己动手判定出来的。: Without this step: all three rules stay at "I know it", and no condition is something students judged with their own hands.
综合：截止频率（ν > νc）+ Uc 的测量链（扫到零点并停住）+ 量程意识。: Synthesis: cutoff frequency (ν > νc) + the Uc measurement chain (scan to zero and stop) + awareness of range. Order of work: choose the line and intensity first, then scan in reverse.

光强拨到 200 μW（400 μW 超量程）；选一条能激发它的谱线；再反向一格: Set the intensity to 200 μW (400 μW is over range); choose a line that can excite it; then increase the reverse voltage one step at a time until the reading first reaches zero.
用 546.1 nm 的绿光照射三种阴极：钠（νc = 5.53×10¹⁴ Hz: Green light of 546.1 nm falls on three cathodes: sodium (νc = 5.53×10¹⁴ Hz), potassium (5.44) and rubidium (5.15). Which cathode gives no photoelectrons?
546.1 nm 的频率是 5.4935×10¹⁴ Hz，只有钠的截止频率比它高: The frequency of 546.1 nm is 5.4935×10¹⁴ Hz; only sodium's cutoff frequency is higher than that, so sodium gives no photoelectrons at all (facts A2.2, B2.1 table 2).
同一频率下把光强调大一倍，下面哪个量会变？: At the same frequency the intensity is doubled. Which quantity changes?
光电子的最大初动能: Maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons
光强只增加单位时间的光子数 → 电子数变多 → 饱和电流变大；遏止电压、最大初动: Intensity only increases the number of photons per unit time → more electrons → a larger saturation current; the stopping voltage, maximum kinetic energy and cutoff frequency are set by the frequency and the metal (facts A2.3, A2.5, check D4).
反向电压从 0 慢慢加大，电流表读数第一次变成 0.000 μA 时的反向电压是: The reverse voltage is slowly raised from 0; the reading first becomes 0.000 μA at a reverse voltage of 1.11 V. In this lesson the Uc box
停在 1.11 V 这一格显示 1.11 V，再加大就变回「—」: shows 1.11 V while you stay on the 1.11 V step, and goes back to "—" if you go further
Uc 格只在「停在反向第一次归零那一格」时显示；再往大加到上一格也是 0 的格子: The Uc box only appears while you are "stopped on the step where the reverse current first reaches zero"; going further to a step whose previous step was also 0 is no longer the "first zero" (facts B2.1 item 8, gate A M1).
同一束 365.0 nm 的紫外光，分别照钠（W₀ 2.29 eV）、钾（2.2: The same 365.0 nm ultraviolet light falls on sodium (W₀ 2.29 eV), potassium (2.25) and rubidium (2.13). The measured stopping voltages are ordered
同一频率下 W₀ 越大，Ek = hν − W₀ 越小，Uc = Ek/e 也越: At the same frequency, the larger W₀, the smaller Ek = hν − W₀, and the smaller Uc = Ek/e; the measurements are 1.11 V (sodium) < 1.15 (potassium) < 1.27 (rubidium), so the order is sodium > potassium > rubidium (facts A2.9, B2.1 table 1).
用同一只光电管测出三点 (8.2192, 1.11)、(7.4129, 0.78: With one phototube you measure three points (8.2192, 1.11), (7.4129, 0.78), (6.8839, 0.56); the fitted slope is a = 0.4117 V/(10¹⁴ Hz). The measured Planck constant h_measured is about
6.6×10⁻³⁴ J·s，与教材值差约 −0.5 %: 6.6×10⁻³⁴ J·s, about −0.5 % from the textbook value
把光强拨到 400 μW，微电流计读数顶在 5.000 μA。此时测出的饱和电流: The intensity is set to 400 μW and the microammeter tops out at 5.000 μA. The saturation current measured now is
超过量程时读数被削平在 5.000 μA（真值 5.8838），所以饱和电流一定: Over range the reading is clipped at 5.000 μA (true value 5.8838), so the saturation current is always measured low; the reverse current is only 0.1–0.6 μA, so Uc is not affected (facts B1.1, B2.1 item 12, check D7).
做完这门课：能用反向扫描测出遏止电压，说清光强只改饱和电流、频率和金属改 Uc，: After this lesson you can measure the stopping voltage by reverse scanning, explain that intensity only changes the saturation current while frequency and metal change Uc, and find Planck's constant from the Uc–ν graph.
